items.summary: Rollins stock slipped 1.4% to about US$34.80 after Q3 2026 earnings landed, a muted move for a pest control heavyweight that just printed more than US$1.0b in quarterly revenue. items.title: ROL Q3 deep dive: AI-driven search disrupts residential leads, management adapts strategy
items.summary: Pest control company Rollins (NYSE:ROL) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales rose 6.2% year on year to $1.09 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.34 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
